text_block_list.text:
Just before the start of the Saudi<n>Arabia R.C., the
student council's<n>general manager comes to wish
Symboli Rudolf well.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rudolf instructs the manager to watch<n>her
performance in the race, and the<n>manager nods.
With that, Rudolf<n>departs for the race full of
confidence.
